decisions_made: Did not attempt items (d)-(f) directly as literally sequenced -- instead diagnosed WHY the previous dispatch's own 'do not attempt a cheap IReuseFrozen_mono shortcut' warning was pointing at a real design gap (IReuseFrozen's IFrozenBelow claim about the CURRENT state cannot be re-derived at any round but the record-time one), and closed that gap first, since items (d)/(e) cannot be honestly completed on top of a companion invariant (IReuseFrozen) that does not itself survive round-to-round.

Designed IReuseFrozenOrigin as a heavier existential (origin snapshot + monotonicity witnesses + content-agreement conjunct) rather than trying to make IReuseFrozen itself inductively maintained via some cheaper mechanism -- verified directly that the natural cheaper routes (deriving IPosPersistRaw fresh for each round's pre-persistence branch, or threading IPosPersistRaw as yet another list-zipped invariant) either do not hold in general or introduce their own unproven preservation gaps (e.g. IPosPersistRaw's own preservation under Branch.extendMany, not built anywhere in the file).

Landed the four supporting lemmas and the IAllReuseFrozenOrigin list companion as free-standing, verified machinery, decoupled from the six-site wiring (item (e)) and the key-statement threading (item (d)) -- keeping this dispatch's unit of work self-contained and independently verifiable, matching the established pattern from items (a)-(c) in prior dispatches.

Re-ran the full CI pipeline in the foreground (not backgrounded) after an earlier background lake test run's completion was flagged as unverifiable by the coordinator -- confirmed lake build, lake test (exit 0, zero errors), checkInitImports, lint, lint-style, shake, mk_all, and sorry/axiom/vacuous counts all directly, with visible command output for each.
dead_ends: Did not attempt to establish IPosPersistRaw fresh at every round's pre-persistence branch via applyPersistenceFixpoint_copy_complete -- that construction only ever establishes IPosPersistRaw about a round's POST-persistence output, never its input, so it cannot discharge IFrozenBelow_applyPersistenceFixpoint's hpp hypothesis directly.

Did not attempt to thread IPosPersistRaw itself as another list-zipped invariant through key (mirroring IAllReuseContain's pattern) as an alternative fix -- this would additionally require proving IPosPersistRaw's own preservation under Branch.extendMany and under raw-edge growth (case7's mint arm), neither of which exists anywhere in the file yet; the origin-tracking route avoids needing this entirely.
